request.description: Combine these TWO EXACT sphere references into ONE continuous celestial globe. BOTTOM HALF = the SOLID LOWER HEMISPHERE FROM REFERENCE 1, with its beautiful fine curved copperplate hatching, dense cross-hatched shadow at bottom-right, bone ivory material, and coordinate lines incised into an opaque rounded shell. TOP HALF = the OPEN LATTICE UPPER HEMISPHERE FROM REFERENCE 2: fine ivory curved longitude/latitude cage ribs, front and rear grid visible through black empty openings, NOT an opaque filled upper surface. The dividing line is the horizontal equator halfway down the globe, at y=256; lower shell joins the upper lattice seamlessly along that equator. Match the two halves in radius, center, camera and meridian alignment so the outline remains a perfect single circle. Keep the small luminous circular core of reference 2 visible in the center at the join. Crucially retain the elegant continuous engraving hatch strokes of reference 1 across the lower half, NOT flat gray checkerboard panels or a plain flat white bowl. The lower half must have spherical shaded volume; the upper half stays hollow. One centered sphere, diameter about 440px on a 512x512 pure black square. Same antique Renaissance woodcut/copperplate pixel-art look, bone-white and charcoal palette. No external armillary hoops, no separate rings, no halo, no extra frame, no pedestal, no detached parts, no lettering, no CGI plastic, no airbrush blur.
